name: pi-session-blackboard
description: Session blackboard for the pi coding agent: deterministic per-turn extraction, agent-curated commits, deterministic archival — and the board itself becomes the compaction summary, so compaction costs zero summarization calls.

scripts.build: node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc src/index.ts src/journal.ts src/summary-import.ts src/extract.ts src/board.ts src/types.ts src/paths.ts src/state.ts src/compact-assist.ts src/summary.ts src/recall.ts src/config.ts --outDir build --module NodeNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/smoke.mjs && node --test test/reliability.mjs test/journal.mjs test/summary-import.mjs test/runtime.mjs test/faults.mjs test/sdk-contract.mjs
